name: Josh's rig (2026-08-31)
description: 4 fixtures, VERIFIED ON HARDWARE by isolated channel probing (not assumed from a spec): laser@1, par@21, moving head@36, wash bar@69. Par is 4CH dimmer+RGB (no white) — a different layout than the packaged default_rig.json's rgb_par assumption, confirmed empirically. Wash bar's 6CH layout matches the packaged assumption (dimmer/strobe/R/G/B/W), but note: R/G/B light a different physical LED zone ("outer") than White ("center") — not a true RGBW mixing pixel, confirmed empirically. Update this file (or make a new one) as the rig changes.
